Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_B: Needs an empty bottle and a fully soured Orléans Vinegar Cask within two squares. Takes 1 L from the cask and gives one vanilla Vinegar.
Tooltip_craft_fermentationVesselDesc: A sealed vessel with a water outlet for the gas. Turns 10 or 20 L of wort and a packet of yeast into fermented wort. Works best at 18 to 25 C.
Tooltip_craft_vinegarCaskDesc: A 30 L cask under a breathable cloth, kept going by the Orleans method: pour in fermented wort, bottle the vinegar once it has fully soured, and leave some behind. Grows a Mother of Vinegar. Works best at 20 to 30 C.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_S: Soaked grain, ready to spread on a Malting Floor.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_G: Sprouted grain. Heat it on a fire or in an oven within a few days to dry it into Malt. Rotten Green Malt won't kiln, but the composter takes it.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_M: Dried and ready to mash. It keeps.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_B: Heat this on a fire or in an oven to turn its starch into sugar.
Tooltip_craft_maltingFloorDesc: A shallow tray for sprouting grain. Holds four lots of Steeped Grain. Works best at 12 to 20 C.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_B: Strain it through a cloth with Strain Mash to get 10 L of wort.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_S: Left over from straining. Put it in a composter.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_M: A living vinegar culture. Add it to an Orléans Vinegar Cask that has none. It dies after about a month in the jar.
